description: This Java source file contains unit tests for the ModuleUtil class within the OpenMRS project, specifically using JUnit 5. The tests cover various utility methods related to module management, version checking, resource path resolution, and repository location handling.

classes.name: ModuleUtilIT
classes.description: A test class extending BaseContextSensitiveTest, containing JUnit 5 test methods to verify behavior of ModuleUtil, including version comparison, resource mapping, module path retrieval, mandatory modules check, and repository configuration.

methods.name: getURLStream_shouldReturnAValidInputStreamForOldModuleUrls
methods.description: Tests that ModuleUtil.getURLStream correctly retrieves a stream from a specified URL.

methods.name: getURL_shouldReturnAnUpdateRdfPageForOldHttpsDevUrls
methods.description: Tests fetching an RDF update page from an HTTPS development URL (currently disabled).

methods.name: checkMandatoryModulesStarted_shouldThrowModuleExceptionIfAMandatoryModuleIsNotStarted
methods.description: Verifies that an exception is thrown if mandatory modules are not started.

methods.name: getMandatoryModules_shouldReturnMandatoryModuleIds
methods.description: Checks that the list of mandatory modules is correctly returned.

methods.name: matchRequiredVersions_shouldAllowRangedRequiredVersion
methods.description: Validates version range matching with specific versions.

methods.name: getPathForResource_shouldHandleUiSpringmvcCssUiDotCssExample
methods.description: Tests resource path mapping for module resource paths.

methods.name: getModuleForPath_shouldHandleUiSpringmvcCssUiDotCssWhenUiDotSpringmvcModuleIsRunning
methods.description: Tests module retrieval based on resource path when a specific module is active.

methods.name: checkRequiredVersion_shouldThrowModuleExceptionIfOpenmrsVersionBeyondWildCardRange
methods.description: Verifies exception is thrown if openmrs version exceeds the required version range.

methods.name: compareVersion_shouldCorrectlyComparingTwoVersionNumbers
methods.description: Tests correct comparison of semantic version strings.

methods.name: getModuleRepository_shouldUseTheRuntimePropertyAsTheFirstChoiceIfSpecified
methods.description: Checks repository location when a runtime property is set.
